# PCA GA Minutes — LLM pack (compact catalogues, one file)

Generated index for AI ingestion. The corpus lives at https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga (raw markdown at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raymond-rishty/pca-ga/main).
This file concatenates the SMALL structured catalogues so you can load them in one fetch:
the Minutes index, the RPR hub, constitutional inquiries, and CCB advice.
The schema-v2 provision catalogue API is available at https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/api/provisions/index.json; BCO compatibility aliases are listed at https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/api/bco/index.json.
Each catalogue row deep-links to the verbatim minutes page; cite as `M<GA>GA p.<page>`.
User-facing links in this pack are canonical GitHub Pages URLs ending in `.html`; source `.md` paths are for raw/repository retrieval only.

Use this pack only as a fallback for corpus-wide or cross-catalogue discovery when no narrower map applies; search it for candidate records, then open and cite the underlying pages.
Three catalogues are too large to inline here — fetch them directly when a question needs them:
- https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/JUDICIAL-CASES.html — canonical one-row-per-rostered-case judicial catalogue (~2.3 MB; fetch on demand)
- https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/OVERTURES.html — every overture + outcome (~104k tokens)
- https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/RPR-BY-PROVISION.html — RPR exceptions of substance by BCO/RAO/WCF provision (~308k tokens)



==============================================================================
# INDEX.md   (live: https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/INDEX.html)
==============================================================================

---
layout: default
title: Minutes Index
description: Browse 52 published volumes of the PCA General Assembly minutes (1973–2025), with a structural outline for each volume and full-text search.
permalink: /index/INDEX.html
---

# PCA General Assembly Minutes — Minutes Index

Browse the **52 published volumes** of the Presbyterian Church in America *Minutes of the General Assembly*, **1973–2025**. Open a volume to read its cleaned, OCR-corrected text, or follow its outline to navigate the meeting record.

# Review of Presbytery Records (RPR) — Exceptions of Substance

Each year the General Assembly's **Committee on Review of Presbytery Records** reviews every presbytery's minutes and flags **exceptions of substance** — apparent violations of the Constitution. This catalogue threads each exception across the years it was disputed (raised → the presbytery responds → a later GA finds the response **satisfactory** or **unsatisfactory**), drawn from the RPR appendix of every volume GA18–52 (1990–2025). The published appendix reflects the **adopted** state (floor strikes already removed); floor-action provenance is noted per row.

## Corpus

- **5935 threaded exceptions of substance** across **100 presbyteries**, GA18–52 (1990–2025), from 10624 report appearances.
- Final disposition: **3333 satisfactory (closed)**, **884 unsatisfactory (outstanding)**, **1718 raised** (most-recent year, not yet adjudicated).
- Cross-reference by provision: **[RPR exceptions by BCO/RAO/WCF provision](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/RPR-BY-PROVISION.html)**.

# INQUIRIES.md   (live: https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/INQUIRIES.html)

# Constitutional Inquiry Catalogue

Questions of constitutional interpretation referred to the CCB or its predecessor and answered with non-binding advice. Grouped by Assembly.

Each entry pairs a Digest headnote with the verbatim record in the minutes. The title and citation come from the canonical inquiry record in `inquiries.jsonl`.

*CCB constitutional review of proposed overtures/amendments is catalogued separately in **[Overture & amendment advice](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/CCB-OVERTURE-ADVICE.html)**.*


## 3rd General Assembly (1975)  ·  `ga03_1975`

| Inquiry | Subject | Synopsis | Provisions | Outcome | Digest citation | From | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-89 | [Session responsibility for budgeting and the diaconate's proper role](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga03_1975__ci01.html) | The CCB responded that BCO 10-2 already assigns budgeting to the session, so no special instruction to sessions was necessary. | BCO 10-2 | advice given | 1975, p. 113, 3-89. | John Holmes | [ga03_1975 p.113](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga03_1975.html#ga03-p115) |

## 4th General Assembly (1976)  ·  `ga04_1976`

| Inquiry | Subject | Synopsis | Provisions | Outcome | Digest citation | From | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4-71 III, A | [BCO 11-2 (Originally 12-2)](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga04_1976__ci01.html) | The CCB directed Rev. Dunkerley to BCO 12-2, noting that church courts have latitude to establish rules not violating the Constitution when a congregation has only one ruling elder and no full session. | BCO 12-2 | advice given | 1976, p. 72, III, A. | Rev. Donald Dunkerley | [ga04_1976 p.72](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga04_1976.html#ga04-p74) |

## 6th General Assembly (1978)  ·  `ga06_1978`

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-111 III | [Meaning and manner of reaffirmation of faith for membership](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga06_1978__ci01.html) | The CCB advised that 'reaffirmation of faith' historically means answering BCO 58-5 questions 1 and 2, but a testimony of Christian experience may also satisfy it, and requesting reaffirmation of transferring members is not improper. | BCO 58-6, BCO 58-5, BCO 12-2 | advice given | 1978, p. 112, III. | Westminster Presbyterian Church, Kingsport, TN | [ga06_1978 p.112](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga06_1978.html#ga06-p112) |

## 10th General Assembly (1982)  ·  `ga10_1982`

| Inquiry | Subject | Synopsis | Provisions | Outcome | Digest citation | From | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10-23 | [General Assembly committee authority over cooperative mission agreements](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga10_1982__ci01.html) | The CCB advised that the Committee of Commissioners channels business to the floor rather than acting as a commission, and the full Assembly retains authority over cooperative agreements. | BCO 14-1-5, BCO 14-1-7, BCO 14-6, BCO 12-5, BCO 13-8, RAO 8-1, BCO 15-1 | advice given | 1982, p. 60, 10-23. |  | [ga10_1982 p.60](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga10_1982.html#ga10-p60) |
| 10-75 III, 10 | [Definition of 'voter' in congregational officer elections](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga10_1982__ci02.html) | A voter under BCO 24-3 is a communing member in good standing present at the meeting; only those who cast a ballot count toward the majority required for election. | BCO 24-3 | advice given | 1982, p. 101, III, 10. | Session of Vineville Presbyterian Church | [ga10_1982 p.101](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga10_1982.html#ga10-p103) |
| 10-75 III, 8 | [Ordination status and restoration process after deposition from office](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga10_1982__ci03.html) | The CCB advised that a deposed officer has no ordination status, and restoration requires at minimum reaffirmation of vows, laying on of hands, and a proper call. | BCO 30-5, BCO 36-7, BCO 37-4, BCO 34-8, BCO 37-7 | advice given | 1982, p. 99, III, 8. | Presbytery of Central Florida | [ga10_1982 p.99](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga10_1982.html#ga10-p99) |
| 10-77 | [Constitutionality of a non-geographical presbytery under BCO 11-4](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga10_1982__ci04.html) | The CCB found that the BCO does not address non-geographical presbyteries, as BCO 11-4 implies geographical bounds while BCO 13-1 does not limit 'bounds' geographically. | BCO 11-4, BCO 13-1 | advice given | 1982, p. 107, 10-77. |  | [ga10_1982 p.107](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga10_1982.html#ga10-p107) |

## 11th General Assembly (1983)  ·  `ga11_1983`

## 12th General Assembly (1984)  ·  `ga12_1984`

| Inquiry | Subject | Synopsis | Provisions | Outcome | Digest citation | From | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12-53 II, 54 | [Teaching elder without a call and BCO 13-5 exceptions](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci01.html) | The CCB advised that BCO 13-5 allows a presbytery to retain a teaching elder without a call in cases it deems necessary, subject to General Assembly review. | BCO 13-5 | advice given | 1984, p. 138, II, 54. | Presbytery of Eastern Canada | [ga12_1984 p.138](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p140) |
| 12-53 II,15 | [Prohibition of dual candidacy under BCO 18-7](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci02.html) | BCO 18-7 permits a candidate to retain home-church membership while under another presbytery's care, but does not allow simultaneous candidacy under two presbyteries. | BCO 18-7, BCO 18-2, BCO 19-1, BCO 19-5 | advice given | 1984, p. 126, II,15. | Grace Presbytery | [ga12_1984 p.126](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p126) |
| 12-53 II, 51 | [Whether a ruling elder moderator must also hold a representative commission](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci03.html) | The CCB advised that a non-representative ruling elder may serve as presbytery moderator, but may only vote when his vote would be determinative. | BCO 10-3, BCO 13-1 | advice given | 1984, p. 137, II, 51. | Session of the First Presbyterian Church of Stanley, North Carolina | [ga12_1984 p.137](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p137) |
| 12-53 III | [Power of a receiving court to broaden charges in a transferred judicial case](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci04.html) | When a judicial case is transferred, the receiving court becomes court of original jurisdiction and may add further charges pertaining to the original matter, but wholly new charges must go back to the first court. | BCO 41-3, BCO 31-2 | advice given | 1984, p. 137, III. | Judicial Commission of Gulf Coast Presbytery | [ga12_1984 p.137](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p137) |
| 12-53 II, 56 | [Scope and duration of BCO debate prohibitions during a complaint](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci05.html) | BCO prohibitions on debate apply only to the specific matter complained, only until final adjudication, and to all members of the lower court — expiring upon final resolution. | BCO 39-2, BCO 42-4, BCO 43-4 | advice given | 1984, p. 139, II, 56. | Central Carolina Presbytery | [ga12_1984 p.139](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p139) |
| 12-53 II | [BCO debate prohibitions during a complaint — ratified GA answer](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci05-02.html) | The GA ratified that BCO debate prohibitions during a complaint apply to the particular matter only, to all lower-court members, and expire upon final adjudication of that complaint. | BCO 39-2, BCO 42-4, BCO 43-4 | advice given | 1984, p. 139, II. | Central Carolina Presbytery | [ga12_1984 p.139](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p139) |
| 12-53 II | [Recourse when General Assembly may have erred in a decision](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci06.html) | The CCB advised that errors alleged during a GA meeting may be challenged under BCO 45, and subsequent assemblies may take contrary positions but cannot annul prior actions. | BCO 43-4, BCO 45 | advice given | 1984, p. 139, II. | St. Louis Presbytery | [ga12_1984 p.139](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p139) |
| 12-53 II, 60 | [Whether congregation may set minimum voting age for elections](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci07.html) | The BCO provides no minimum voting age for congregational meetings, except where state law imposes one for corporate votes. | BCO 6-2, BCO 6-4, BCO 24-3, BCO 25-1, BCO 25-3, BCO 25-11 | advice given | 1984, p. 140, II, 60. | Texas Presbytery | [ga12_1984 p.140](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p140) |
| 12-53 III, 62 | [Minimum ruling elders required to constitute a valid session](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci08.html) | The CCB advised that one ruling elder plus a pastor constitutes a valid session, but a church without a pastor requires at least two ruling elders. | BCO 12-1 | advice given | 1984, p. 141, III, 62. | Central Georgia Presbytery | [ga12_1984 p.141](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p141) |
| 12-53 III,69 | [Ordination of men who believe women may serve as deacons](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci09.html) | Believing Scripture permits women deacons, while agreeing to abide by BCO standards in practice, is not by itself sufficient grounds to deny ordination or reception in the PCA. | BCO 7-2, BCO 9-3, BCO 21-5 | advice given | 1984, p. 142, III,69. |  | [ga12_1984 p.142](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p142) |
| 12-73 | [Propriety of abstractly listing disqualifying beliefs for ordination](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci10.html) | The GA declined to determine abstractly which beliefs disqualify a man from office, holding that only proper judicial processes may make such binding determinations. | BCO 21-5 | advice given | 1984, p. 153, 12-73. | TE Bruce W. Howes et al. | [ga12_1984 p.153](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p153) |
| 12-83 | [Handling exceptions at ordination and distinctions between BCO and confessional exceptions](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga12_1984__ci11.html) | Courts must investigate stated exceptions; BCO exceptions under vow 3 are handled differently from doctrinal exceptions under vow 2, with judicial process available if warranted. | BCO 21-5, BCO 27-37 | advice given | 1984, p. 165, 12-83. | Central Carolina Presbytery | [ga12_1984 p.165](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga12_1984.html#ga12-p165) |

| 29-28 III.2 | [Requirement that Candidates or Officers Receive More than a Majority](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci02.html) | A Session cannot raise the voting requirement beyond a majority for calling a pastor, dissolving a pastoral relation, or electing a church officer. | BCO 20-4, BCO 24-4 | advice given | 2001, p. 134, III.2. | Eastern Carolina Presbytery | [ga29_2001 p.134](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p134) |
| 29-28 III.3 | [Divesting a Teaching Elder Without Call](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci03.html) | The CCB advised that a presbytery is not required to divest a teaching elder without call after three years, but must inquire and exercise discretion after completing its inquiry. |  | advice given | 2001, p. 134, III.3. | Southern Florida Presbytery | [ga29_2001 p.134](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p134) |
| 29-28 III.4 | [Minimum Age for Communicant Membership](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci04.html) | The CCB advised that sessions must evaluate each membership request individually regardless of age, since the timing of credible faith cannot be precisely fixed. | BCO 6-2, BCO 57-2 | advice given | 2001, p. 134, III.4. | Pittsburgh Presbytery | [ga29_2001 p.134](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p134) |
| 29-28 III.5 | [Communion Practice and Prohibited Exceptions](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci05.html) | The CCB advised Great Lakes Presbytery that BCO 58-4 allows no exception of practice in administering the Lord's Supper, and presbyteries should use BCO 34-5 when considering exceptions from candidates. | BCO 58-4, BCO 34-5 | advice given | 2001, p. 135, III.5. | Great Lakes Presbytery | [ga29_2001 p.135](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p135) |
| 29-28 III.6 | [Right of Complaint Against a Court's Actions](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci06.html) | The CCB advised that a complainant may not go to a higher court until the lower court has acted on the complaint pursuant to BCO 43-2 and 43-3. | BCO 43-2, BCO 43-3, BCO 43-1 | advice given | 2001, p. 136, III.6. | Philadelphia Presbytery | [ga29_2001 p.136](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p136) |
| 29-28 III.7 | [CCB Providing Unsolicited Advice to Committees](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci07.html) | The CCB advised New River Presbytery that it lacks authority to give unsolicited advice to other committees, though the CRPR may make any recommendation within its RAO 16 purview to the GA. | RAO 14, RAO 16 | advice given | 2001, p. 137, III.7. | New River Presbytery | [ga29_2001 p.137](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p137) |
| 29-28 Item 3 | [General Assembly Amending a Report of the SJC](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci09.html) | The CCB advised that the GA may not amend the SJC's report by deleting a concurring opinion, since under BCO 15-5 an SJC decision is the final decision of the Assembly. | BCO 15-5 | advice given | 2001, p. 144, Item 3. |  | [ga29_2001 p.144](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p144) |
| 29-28 Item 4 | [Rendering Opinion on Assembly Action](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci10.html) | The CCB advised that the SJC may only address matters assigned to it, but once assigned a matter may render an opinion on the legitimacy of the GA action that prompted the referral. |  | advice given | 2001, p. 145, Item 4. |  | [ga29_2001 p.145](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p145) |
| 29-28 Item 1 | [Temperate Language in Concurring or Dissenting Opinions](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci11.html) | The CCB held that determination of temperateness must occur before a concurring opinion is appended, and that such opinions represent only individual views, not the mind of the Church or binding SJC decisions. | OMSJC 14.7, OMSJC 18.12.b, OMSJC 17.8.k, BCO 14.7, OMSJC 18.3, OMSJC 18.12.a, OMSJC 14-7 | advice given | 2001, p. 147, Item 1. |  | [ga29_2001 p.147](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p147) |
| 29-28 Item 2 | [Relationship of Ordination Vows to Constitution and Rules of Operation](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci12.html) | The CCB advised that delegates are bound by ordination vows to follow PCA constitutional rules, and that changing unscriptural standards requires proper amendment procedures, not suspension. | BCO 21-5.2, BCO 21-5.3, BCO 21-5.4, BCO 21-5.5, BCO 24-6.2, BCO 24-6.3, BCO 24-6.4, BCO 24-6.5, BCO Preface III, BCO 45 | advice given | 2001, p. 148, Item 2. |  | [ga29_2001 p.148](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p148) |
| 29-28 Item 2 | [Procedure for Suspending Rules](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga29_2001__ci12-02.html) | The CCB advised that delegates are bound to follow the Constitution as fully as possible and declined to affirm that rules must be suspended to obey Christ, directing any changes through proper amendment procedures. | BCO 21-5.2-5, BCO 24-6.2-5, BCO Preface III, BCO 45 | advice given | 2001, p. 148, Item 2. |  | [ga29_2001 p.148](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga29_2001.html#ga29-p148) |

| App. O, section III (Supplemental Report) III | [Whether "Inactive Elders" or Ruling Elders Elected at a Different Church May Serve as Commissioners at General Assembly](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga42_2014__ci05.html) | A rotating-session inactive elder may be elected GA commissioner, but a ruling elder never elected in that congregation may not serve as its commissioner. | BCO 7-2, BCO 24-7, BCO 24-9 | advice given | 2014, p. 347, III. | Grace Presbytery | [ga42_2014 p.347](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga42_2014.html#ga42-p347) |

# CCB-OVERTURE-ADVICE.md   (live: https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/CCB-OVERTURE-ADVICE.html)

# CCB Advice on Overtures & Proposed Amendments

The CCB's advice on whether a proposed overture or amendment conflicts with the Constitution. Grouped by Assembly.

Each entry pairs a Digest headnote with the verbatim record in the minutes. The title and citation come from the canonical inquiry record in `inquiries.jsonl`.

*Questions about constitutional meaning are catalogued separately in **[Constitutional inquiries](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/INQUIRIES.html)**.*


## 17th General Assembly (1989)  ·  `ga17_1989`

| Inquiry | Subject | Synopsis | Provisions | Outcome | Digest citation | From | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 17-82 III, 19 | [Retired ministers' reporting obligations in presbytery standing rules](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga17_1989__ci02.html) | A standing rule exempting retired ministers from mandatory reporting does not conflict with BCO 23-2, and the presbytery may rewrite such rules using its own wisdom under BCO 41-5. | BCO 23-2, BCO 41-5 | not in conflict | 1989, p. 157, III, 19. | Illiana Presbytery | [ga17_1989 p.157](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga17_1989.html#ga17-p159) |
| 17-82 III,19 | [Presbytery standing rule exempting retired ministers from reporting](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/inquiries/ga17_1989__ci05.html) | Illiana Presbytery's proposed rule relieving retired ministers from mandatory reporting was found not in conflict with BCO 23-2, with the presbytery advised to use its own wisdom under BCO 41-5. | BCO 23-2, BCO 41-5 | not in conflict | 1989, p. 157, III,19. | Illiana Presbytery | [ga17_1989 p.157](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga17_1989.html#ga17-p157) |
